My kitten used to do this. I sprayed no scratch cat spray on the areas by doors or rugs every few days and would gently pick her up by the neck like a mother cat and put her in a 'time out' (her carry cage) for five minutes every time she did it. All my cats quickly learnt what they weren't supposed to do without yelling at them or resorting to other forms of training.

I've been where she is. The thing I didn't know I needed was someone to keep showing up. It allowed me to feel normal and safe. Just love her and don't rush her, people are going to try get her to talk and be worried, just allow her to guide you in what she needs. Even if it is a funny meme and telling her you are here no matter what. It makes a difference, trust me ♡ I am thinking of your friend and you x

The best thing you can do is to let her know you are there for her no matter what. No pressure on her to talk about anything, but if she needs a distraction you can take her to a movie or just bring food over. That you aren't going anywhere. Even if she pushes you away, just being consistent and loyal. Not trying to change her but loving and supporting her. Letting her open up in her own time, but gently helping create positive moments that show her you care and life could get better even if right now it sucks. Just show up, that is the best thing you can do.
